mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EMP ( EMP_ID, EMP_PW, HOSP_DIV_ID, WARD_ID, EMP_NM, ROLE_CD, AUTH_ST, MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{passwordHash}, #{hospitalId}, #{wardId}, #{userName}, #{role}, 'ACTIVE', TRUE )
